agent.label: Agent
agent.definition: A durable non-human identity only when independently owned.

desk.label: Desk
desk.definition: A private Member-indexed Place with a bound Root.

meeting.label: Meeting
meeting.definition: A present collaboration event with Occupants and disposition.

member.label: Member
member.definition: A human owner of judgment and consent.

place.label: Place
place.definition: A governed addressable location or sovereignty boundary.

room.label: Room
room.definition: A Place owning one durable semantic domain.

shelf.label: Shelf
shelf.definition: A typed Placement contract inside a Place.

site.label: Site
site.definition: A Workplace declaration of a sovereign external Root.

work.label: Work
work.definition: A commitment to a bounded durable Outcome.

workbench.label: Workbench
workbench.definition: A reconstructible projection of the Items needed now.

workshop.label: Workshop
workshop.definition: A situated resolution of Work, Place, Equipment and Authority.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.definition: A Place used for a bounded responsibility.
